table.name: employee
table.purpose: One row per employee, identified by Employee_ID, with name, age, and city/team. Names are English rugby players and 'City' values are English rugby club names, suggesting a sports-related dataset (possibly employees assigned to club branches/teams). Referenced by hiring (one-to-one) and evaluation (many evaluations per employee).

City.name: City
City.description: Location/grouping of the employee. Values are English rugby club names (Bath, Bristol, Leicester, Sale, Wasps) rather than plain cities, so it may actually denote the club/team or branch the employee belongs to; the column name 'City' is only partially supported.

Employee_ID.name: Employee_ID
Employee_ID.description: Primary key; unique employee identifier (1-10). Referenced one-to-one by hiring.Employee_ID and one-to-many by evaluation.Employee_ID.

Name.name: Name
Name.description: Employee's full name (first + last). All values are names of English rugby union players.

table.name: evaluation
table.purpose: Records annual bonus awards given to employees, one row per employee per award year, linking to the employee table via Employee_ID.

Bonus.name: Bonus
Bonus.description: Monetary bonus amount awarded to the employee, in whole currency units (e.g., pounds/dollars); values range 2900-4000.

Employee_ID.name: Employee_ID
Employee_ID.description: Identifier of the employee who received the bonus; references employee.Employee_ID (many-to-one).

Year_awarded.name: Year_awarded
Year_awarded.description: Calendar year in which the bonus was awarded (2011-2018).

table.name: hiring
table.purpose: Records each employee's shop assignment: which shop they were hired into, whether the position is full-time, and the year they started. One row per employee (one_to_one with employee).

Employee_ID.name: Employee ID
Employee_ID.description: Identifier of the employee; references employee.Employee_ID (one_to_one). Serves as this table's logical key.

Is_full_time.name: Is full time
Is_full_time.description: Whether the employee's position is full-time ('T') or part-time ('F'), stored as text.

Shop_ID.name: Shop ID
Shop_ID.description: Identifier of the shop the employee works at; references shop.Shop_ID (many_to_one).

Start_from.name: Start year
Start_from.description: Year the employee started working at the shop (values 2003–2013, stored as text).

table.name: shop
table.purpose: Despite the table name 'shop', the data is clearly a list of Finnish football clubs (Veikkausliiga teams) with their home stadium, city, and head coach. Each row is one club. The 'shop' naming is likely a mislabeled or disguised table; it is referenced by 'hiring' via Shop_ID, which likely stores club employees/staff.

District.name: Home stadium
District.description: Name of the club's home stadium/venue (e.g. Finnair Stadium for HJK, Veritas Stadion for FC Inter, Tapiolan Urheilupuisto for FC Honka). The column name 'District' is misleading; values are stadium names, one per club.

Location.name: Home city
Location.description: Finnish city where the club is based (Helsinki, Espoo, Turku, Lahti, Jakobstad, etc.), matching the stadium location.

Manager_name.name: Head coach / manager
Manager_name.description: Full name of the club's head coach (e.g. Antti Muurinen at HJK, Job Dragtsma at FC Inter, Mika Lehkosuo at FC Honka).

Name.name: Club name
Name.description: Name of the football club (HJK, FC Honka, FC Inter, FC Haka, KuPS, IFK Mariehamn, etc.), all Finnish Veikkausliiga clubs.

Shop_ID.name: Club ID
Shop_ID.description: Primary key, integer 1-9, one per club. Referenced by hiring.Shop_ID, so the 'hiring' table links staff/employees to clubs.
